name: Welcome drinks
summary: Come say hello the night before. Snacks, local cider and a very relaxed dress code.
details:
We have the back room and the garden at The Half Moon. There will be plenty to eat, so treat it as dinner. Drop in whenever you arrive in town; there are no speeches.

The Half Moon is a ten-minute walk from The Wren. Street parking on Warren Street is free after 6 pm.

name: Ceremony
summary: Under the oldest apple trees on the farm. Please arrive by 4:10 pm.
details:
The ceremony is outdoors, on grass, under the oldest trees in the orchard. Chairs are set out from 3:45 pm. It will be short and sweet, about twenty-five minutes.

This is an unplugged ceremony: please keep phones away until we have walked back down the aisle. Our photographer will share everything.

If it rains, the ceremony moves into the Big Barn and we will text everyone by noon.

name: Cocktail hour
summary: Drinks, oysters and lawn games while we take photos.
details: Willowbank's own cider, a signature drink each, and oysters from the Hudson Valley. Lawn games are out on the courtyard, and Biscuit will be doing the rounds until her bedtime.

name: Dinner and dancing
summary: Long tables, short speeches, and a band that knows every song you'll request.
details:
Dinner is served family style at long tables in the barn. Choose your main course when you RSVP. After dinner the band takes over until 11 pm.

The last shuttles leave at 11:15 pm. If you're staying for the after-party, there are later shuttles; see the guest page.

name: The after-party
summary: Late-night snacks and a DJ downstairs for anyone who isn't ready to go home.
details: Head down the stone stairs at the back of the barn. Grilled cheese at midnight, a DJ, and the shuttle back to town at 12:15 and 1:15 am.

name: Farewell brunch
summary: Coffee, pastries and one last hug before everyone heads home.
details: Drop by any time in the morning. Coffee from Fieldstone Bakery, a big breakfast spread, and the leftover cake. A shuttle runs from both hotels at 9:45 and 10:30 am.
